faqs.a:
For each regular employee, the appointing authority, or designee thereof, will complete
               an evaluation of the employee's performance annually and at such other times as deemed
               appropriate by the appointing authority. The appointing authority or designee may
               perform unscheduled evaluations as necessary. The original performance evaluation
               must be placed in the personnel file kept in the human resources department. A copy
               may also be placed in the supervisor's file.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
